dek: Police today (August 26) appealed to the public for information on a man who went missing in Sha Tin. Chiu Tak-cheung, aged 71, went missing after he left his residence on Siu Lek Yuen Road yesterday (August 25) morning. His family made a report to Police today. He is about 1.7 metres tall, around 59 kilograms in weigh
